subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when placed from left to right in the same sequence in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

MN_ _LMM_ _PLM_ _NP_MMNN_ _M
solution:
Given series: MN_ _LMM_ _PLM_ _NP_MMNN_ _M

Option 1) NPNNMNLPL → MN__**N**__ __**P**__LMM__**N**__ __**N**__PLM__**M**__ __**N**__NP__**L**__MMNN__**P**__ __**L**__M → (It follows the pattern of: MNNPL - MMNNPL - MMNNPL - MMNNPL)

Option 2) NPNNMNLPP → MN__N__ __P__LMM__N__ __N__PLM__M__ __N__NP__L__MMNN__P__ __L__M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) NNNNMNLPL → MN__N__ __P__LMM__N__ __N__PLM__M__ __N__NP__L__MMNN__P__ __L__M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) MPNNMNLPL → MN__N__ __P__LMM__N__ __N__PLM__M__ __N__NP__L__MMNN__P__ __L__M → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
